name: 11721 · Centerport, NY
findings: ZIP 11721 (Centerport) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11721 (Centerport) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
